positions.stance: Running as a loyal supporter of President Trump and the America First movement who will "carry the torch" for Trump's agenda.
Pledges to take on "Big Food and Big Pharma," saying corporate interests have put profits ahead of Americans' health.
Running to help President Trump finish the border wall and protect national sovereignty.
Promises "no compromise" on conservative principles and to defend constitutional freedoms against the left and "RINO Republicans."
Will work with President Trump to advance an America First foreign policy that promotes "peace through strength" rather than sending billions abroad.

S6TX00479.name: James Talarico
S6TX00479.bio: Former sixth-grade public school teacher who has served four terms in the Texas House of Representatives.

positions.stance: Plans an anti-corruption package to ban super PACs and corporate PACs, ban congressional stock trading, and close billionaire tax loopholes.
Will cut taxes for working people, cap credit card interest rates, and lower costs by making billionaires and giant corporations pay their fair share.
Will keep public money in public schools, hire more teachers, raise teacher pay, and bring universal Pre-K to every Texas family.
Will protect Texans' health insurance and Medicaid, lower drug costs and medical debt, and end Texas' maternal mortality crisis; "health care is a human right."
Defends the separation of church and state, opposes book bans, and supports paid family leave and affordable child care.

S6FL00640.name: Ashley Moody
S6FL00640.bio: Former federal prosecutor, circuit judge and Florida Attorney General, appointed to the U.S. Senate in January 2025.

S6FL00830.name: Angie Nixon
S6FL00830.bio: Florida State Representative and former labor organizer from Jacksonville.

positions.stance: Believes government "should work for working people — not corporations, not billionaires."
Supports Medicare for All, saying the U.S. does not guarantee health care to all its people.
Supports universal child care and Pre-K.
Supports quality public education and says getting an education "shouldn't mean a lifetime of debt."
Supports "housing you can actually afford," citing high rents and Wall Street landlords buying up housing.
Running to make life more affordable, saying prices on everything from food to health care continue to rise.
Wants to expand opportunities for the middle class so hard work is "a pathway to a middle class life."
Pledges to protect Americans' rights and democracy from what she calls unprecedented attacks by Donald Trump and his allies.
"I will fight to lower the cost-of-living so everyone in our great state can achieve their own version of the American Dream."
Calls for "common sense solutions, not extreme agendas" that put families first and expand opportunity for the next generation.
Pledges to represent "all of Illinois, not just Chicago," saying working families in all 102 counties deserve to be heard.

S8GA00180.name: Jon Ossoff
S8GA00180.bio: U.S. Senator from Georgia and former investigative journalist.

S6GA00390.name: Mike Collins
S6GA00390.bio: Trucking business owner and U.S. Representative from Jackson, Georgia.

S6NC00407.name: Roy Cooper
S6NC00407.bio: Former Governor and four-term Attorney General of North Carolina.

positions.stance: Would oppose "chaotic tariffs," block anti-competitive grocery mergers, and ban algorithmic grocery pricing to lower food costs.
Would reinstate ACA tax credits, reverse Medicaid cuts, cap out-of-pocket prescription costs, and broaden Medicare drug price negotiations.
Wants data centers to pay the full cost of their power, a ban on shutoffs during extreme weather, and a modernized energy grid.
Would expand the Child and Dependent Care Tax Credit, grow the child care workforce, and offer employer tax credits for child care.
Would encourage more home building, restrict corporate buyers of single-family homes, and ban algorithm-driven rent setting.

S6NC00415.name: Michael Whatley
S6NC00415.bio: Former Chairman of the North Carolina Republican Party and the Republican National Committee.

positions.stance: "I am committed to advancing President Trump's America First agenda as the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina."
Pledges to restore law and order, "back the blue without apology," and roll back lenient criminal justice policies.
"100% supportive" of President Trump securing the border and deporting criminal illegal aliens.
Supports fiscal responsibility, reining in federal spending, and "unleashing American energy" to create jobs and achieve energy independence.
Will defend Second Amendment rights, protect life, support law enforcement, and keep "radical woke ideology" out of schools.

S6MI00418.name: Abdul El-Sayed
S6MI00418.bio: Physician who rebuilt Detroit's Health Department and led Wayne County's Department of Health, Human & Veterans Services.

positions.stance: A top priority is to "get money out of politics."
Pledges to "put money in your pocket" and build an economy that works for everyone.
Will work to "pass Medicare for All."
Fighting for "affordable housing for all."
Fighting for clean air and water.

S4MI00595.name: Mike Rogers
S4MI00595.bio: Army veteran and former FBI agent who chaired the House Intelligence Committee.

positions.stance: "I'll stand with President Trump to deliver on the mandate given to him by the American people."
Wants to bring manufacturing jobs back home.
Pledges to lower the cost of gas, groceries, and prescription drugs.
Pledges to protect seniors' Social Security and Medicare.
Wants to set kids up for success "by prioritizing education not indoctrination."

S4NJ00185.name: Cory Booker
S4NJ00185.bio: Former Newark city council member and mayor, U.S. Senator since 2013.

positions.stance: Advocates abolishing the IRS and Internal Revenue Code for a 10%–12% flat income tax, and ending capital gains, estate taxes, and the AMT.
Says American families need to own their homes, and "the best homeownership policy is a gainfully employed middle-class, and low interest rates."
Supports school choice and abolishing the federal Department of Education, dividing its budget among local school boards.
Says America's military "should remain second-to-none" and that political correctness and DEI should be removed from it.
Supports finishing the southern border wall, securing the northern border, withholding aid from sanctuary jurisdictions, and stationing the military on the border.

S6VA00093.name: Mark Warner
S6VA00093.bio: U.S. Senator from Virginia who became Chairman of the Senate Intelligence Committee in 2021.

positions.stance: Plans to expand housing supply by speeding permitting, encouraging rehabilitation, and easing first mortgages; also addressing the child care labor crisis.
Believes every American should have access to an affordable basic standard of care to lower premiums and keep the system sustainable.
Says AI companies and big corporations must help prepare workers and pay their share of AI's energy demands on the grid.
Cites his role as a primary author of the bipartisan infrastructure bill funding rural broadband and transportation projects.
Cites writing the CHIPS and Science Act to bring advanced manufacturing back to America and championing clean-energy jobs.

S8VA00321.name: Bert Mizusawa
S8VA00321.bio: Retired U.S. Army Major General, former Deputy Under Secretary of the Army, and founder of private enterprises including a law practice.

positions.stance: Criticizes the growth of the national debt and a "tax-and-spend agenda" in Washington.
"I will lower the tax on selling your home, lower the tax burden on Virginia families, and help bring down the cost of living."
Will protect veterans' benefits, expand access to quality health care, and ensure veterans aren't stuck waiting for care.
"I will ban congressional stock trading, so politicians put their constituents first, not themselves."
Will lower health care costs by holding insurance companies accountable and funding rural hospitals.

S4MA00028.name: Ed Markey
S4MA00028.bio: U.S. Senator since 2013 and former member of the U.S. House and Massachusetts House of Representatives.

positions.stance: Fighting to lower costs, protect workers, expand opportunity, and help every family build a stable future.
Fighting to lower costs, expand access, strengthen public health, and hold corporations accountable.
Supports investing in clean energy, modernizing infrastructure, expanding transit, and protecting natural resources.
Fighting to protect civil rights and defend immigrants and LGBTQ+ Americans.
Fighting to strengthen gun laws, invest in prevention, protect constitutional rights, and ensure a fair justice system.

S6MA00304.name: John Deaton
S6MA00304.bio: Trial attorney and U.S. Marine veteran.

positions.stance: Calls affordable health care "a human right"; would break up vertically integrated insurers and PBM monopolies and lower drug costs.
Supports permitting reform with real approval deadlines and opposes green-energy mandates that raise building costs.
Opposes the Green New Deal and supports an all-of-the-above energy approach including nuclear, renewables, and amending the Jones Act.
Supports free voter ID, term limits, ending congressional insider trading, and rejects efforts that make voting harder for eligible citizens.
Would secure the border, end catch-and-release, and reform asylum while expanding legal immigration; rejects both blanket amnesty and mass deportation.

S4TN00542.name: Marquita Bradshaw
S4TN00542.bio: Executive director of the environmental justice nonprofit Sowing Justice.

positions.stance: Supports well-funded public schools and competitive pay, resources, and respect for teachers.
Supports good-paying jobs, small businesses, and fair wages to build "an economy that works for every family."
Will support policies expanding affordable housing, assisting renters and first-time homebuyers, and addressing homelessness.
"Healthcare Is a Right"; supports lower drug costs, protecting rural hospitals, and expanding mental-health and maternal care.
Supports fair voting laws, transparent elections, and independent redistricting to end gerrymandering.

S0CO00575.name: John Hickenlooper
S0CO00575.bio: Former brewpub owner and Colorado governor, now a U.S. Senator.

positions.stance: Championing legislation to stop officials from using insider information or their positions to enrich themselves.
Takes no corporate PAC money; supports overturning Citizens United and stricter disclosure rules for political money.
Opposes the president's "illegal tariff-taxes" and supports expanding access to capital for small businesses.
"A strong supporter of labor unions"; co-sponsors the PRO Act to strengthen workers' rights.
Working to lower housing costs by preventing large corporations from dominating the housing market and cutting red tape.
Will fight to cut federal taxes, roll back regulations, and "restore American energy dominance."
Will support law enforcement funding and work to end programs that release violent criminals before rehabilitation.
Supports vetted legal immigration of people who are nonviolent, self-reliant, and "will proudly assimilate into American culture."
Backs cutting red tape and private-sector solutions to lower costs for farmers and ranchers.
Takes no corporate PAC money; supports reversing Citizens United and banning stock trading by members of Congress and the president.
Believes "people deserve health care, not just health insurance" and that doctors and patients should make care decisions.
"Supports an America where one good job is enough" to pay the bills and save.
Wants government to provide market and infrastructure stability for farm families.
Supports action on climate change and renewable energy development, citing Minnesota's 100% carbon-free electricity goal.
Supports deporting immigrants convicted of fraud and mandatory minimum federal sentences for fraudsters.
Will push for more funding, equipment, and training for law enforcement and oppose removing their legal protections.
Supports enforcing immigration law, deporting criminal illegal aliens, and opposes efforts to abolish ICE.
Will oppose any tax increase on the middle class and protect the "Working Family Tax Cuts."
Will fight "bureaucrats, middlemen and price-gougers," cut prescription drug costs, and "keep power in the hands of patients."
Supports a public option, protecting and expanding Medicaid and Medicare, lowering drug costs, and keeping rural hospitals open.
Would end tax breaks for the ultra-wealthy, raise wages, strengthen workers' rights, and expand child care and paid family leave.
Would fully fund public schools and special education, raise teacher pay, and expand affordable child care and early learning.
Would restore the protections of Roe v. Wade and guarantee access to contraception and infertility care.
Takes no corporate PAC money; supports banning corporate PAC and dark money, a congressional stock-trading ban, and term limits.

S6SC04437.name: Darline Graham
S6SC04437.bio: Former agency head at the South Carolina Commission for the Blind with nearly 30 years in state service.

positions.stance: Will work to make the Trump tax cuts permanent, root out federal waste and fraud, and cut taxes and red tape for small business.
Supports finishing the wall, fully funding border enforcement, ending catch-and-release, and opposing amnesty.
Pro-life; supports mothers, adoption, and pregnancy resource centers and opposes taxpayer funding of abortion.
Supports voter ID, accurate voter rolls, and transparent counting; opposes federal takeovers of state elections.
Opposes defunding the police and backs tough penalties for fentanyl traffickers and violent repeat offenders.

S6AL00476.name: Barry Moore
S6AL00476.bio: Small business owner, Alabama National Guard veteran, and U.S. Representative.

positions.stance: Believes there should be "zero tolerance for illegal immigration"; supports deporting all illegal immigrants and making English the official language.
Working with President Trump to cut regulations and shrink government; "all government has to do is get out of the way."
Will "fully fund law enforcement" and supports prosecuting violent criminals to the fullest extent of the law.
"Believes in the right to keep and bear arms – period" and says federal gun confiscation must be resisted.
Supports lower taxes for small business owners and less Washington involvement in running the economy.

S6AL00518.name: Everett Wess
S6AL00518.bio: Attorney and managing partner of The Wess Law Firm who serves as a Midfield Municipal Court judge.

positions.stance: Says economic opportunity is vital and supports quality public education.
Supports affordable health care, including funding medical providers in rural Alabama and hospitals in underserved areas.
Advocates "fair courts and a clean government that serves all citizens."

S6LA00615.name: Jamie Davis
S6LA00615.bio: Business owner and Delta farmer who served on the Tensas Parish Police Jury.

positions.stance: Will bring real economic development and good jobs to Louisiana communities, including small towns.
Would roll back portions of the 2025 tax law that cut taxes for billionaires and added to the debt.
Would raise the federal minimum wage, which remains $7.25 in Louisiana.
Would build affordable housing and address the housing insurance crisis.
Would crack down on price-gouging at the pump when refiners post record profits.

S6LA00664.name: Julia Letlow
S6LA00664.bio: Educator who represents Louisiana's 5th Congressional District.

positions.stance: "Secure the Border and Deport Criminal Illegal Aliens."
"Lower Costs and Make Life Affordable Again," blaming Washington's spending for inflation.
Says families "should have the final say in how their children are educated, raised, and protected."
"Protect Women's Sports and Defend Common Sense."
Supports passing the SAVE America Act so that elections are secure, transparent, and trustworthy.
